items.claim: Atlassian Design System foundations include design tokens, color, spacing, typography, grid, iconography, elevation, and related primitives beneath components.
Atlassian spacing guidance uses an 8-pixel base unit and related increments to create consistent spatial rhythm.
items.notes: Exact base relationship documented by Atlassian.

items.claim: Atlassian components are designed to inherit shared foundations and tokens so interaction states remain consistent across products.
items.notes: Supports shared grammar across product family.

items.claim: The system's taste comes from coherent cross-product relationships more than any one Atlassian-branded color or component shape.
